description: You are using Aerobridge, an open-source drone/UAV fleet management system. Your task is to create a new flight operation record. Log in to the admin panel at http://localhost:8000/admin/ using username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'. Navigate to the 'Gcs Operations' (or 'GCS Operations') section and find 'Flight Operations'. Click '+ Add' to add a new flight operation. Fill in the required fields: (1) Name: enter 'Rajasthan Corridor Inspection', (2) Drone: select any available aircraft (e.g. 'F1 #1' or 'F1 #2'), (3) Flight plan: select any available flight plan (e.g. 'Flight Plan A'), (4) Operator: select any available operator from the dropdown, (5) Purpose: select any available activity (e.g. 'photographing'), (6) Pilot: select any available pilot from the dropdown, (7) Start datetime: enter a valid date (e.g. '2026-01-15') in the Date field and a time (e.g. '10:00:00') in the Time field, (8) End datetime: enter a date (e.g. '2026-01-15') and time (e.g. '12:00:00') in the End datetime fields (both start and end datetime are required). Save the flight operation record. Do not log out after saving.
